Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of HD.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $3.96 per share.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 18% to 19% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2020.
Our gross margin expanded by 160 basis points to 23.0%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Revenue guidance of $7.1 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1175 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 160 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
